transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I just can’t seem to shake this really heavy, hopeless feeling. It’s honestly like everything I built back up after my divorce has just completely collapsed, and I’m just sitting underneath it all.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hopeless feeling?
It's been about a month now. It started right around the time I realized what a financial mess the divorce left me in, and it's just been hanging over me ever since.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

No, not really. I used to love hiking on the weekends, or even just reading a good book after work, but lately... I just don't have the energy or the interest. Nothing really sounds appealing anymore. I just sort of sit there.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to live or hurting yourself?

Yes, I have. I’ve been thinking lately that it would just be easier if I didn’t wake up in the morning. The thoughts started getting pretty intense, and... honestly, I scared myself. That's actually what made me finally call the employee assistance program at work to get help.
Have you noticed any changes in your movement or activity level, such as feeling restless or slowed down?

Not really, no. I mean... I'm sitting around a lot more, like I mentioned, but that's mostly just because I don't have the energy to get up and do anything. I wouldn't say I feel physically slowed down or restless, though. Just... really tired.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?
No, my weight has been pretty much the same. I haven't really noticed any big changes with that.
How often do you have these thoughts of not wanting to live or hurting yourself?

It's been happening almost every day lately. Like I mentioned a couple of minutes ago, it's usually just me thinking that it would be easier if I didn't wake up. But it started happening so often, and the thoughts got intense enough that I really scared myself... which is why I finally called the employee assistance program to get help.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions?

Yes, definitely. It's actually really affecting my work. I'm a civil engineer, and lately... I'll look at a basic drainage calculation or a spreadsheet that I've used for years, and my mind just goes completely blank. I just sit there rereading the same numbers over and over, and I can't even trust myself to make a simple decision about it.
Have you experienced any feelings of worthlessness?

Yes, a lot. I just keep telling myself that I’m a terrible engineer and a failed wife. I feel like a burden to everyone around me right now. I'll just sit there and replay every missed calculation from work, or every tense email I've sent or received, and it just feels like... like proof that I ruin things.
Have you experienced any psychic anxiety, like feelings of nervousness or apprehension?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel nervous or on edge about things. It's not really anxiety... it's more just that heavy, awful feeling of being useless that I mentioned. But as far as feeling apprehensive or anxious, no, I haven't really noticed that.
Have you experienced any periods in the last month where you felt slightly better for a few days before the heavy, hopeless feeling returned?

No, I haven't. It's... it's been pretty constant, honestly. I haven't had any days where I felt better or like things were lifting. It's just been that same heavy feeling every single day this past month.
Have you experienced any periods in the last month where you felt even slightly better for a few hours before the heavy, hopeless feeling returned?
No... no, not even for a few hours. Like I was saying, it really is just constant. I wake up with it, and it stays with me all day. There haven't been any breaks or moments where it feels lighter.
Have you had any difficulty performing daily tasks like showering, dressing, or feeding yourself?

No, I haven't had any trouble with that. I mean, it takes a lot of effort sometimes to just get out of bed and get moving, but I'm still showering every day, getting dressed, and eating. I haven't stopped doing any of those basic things.
Have you experienced any periods in the last month where you felt better for at least two weeks before the heavy, hopeless feeling returned?
No, not at all. Like I said, it hasn't lifted even for a few hours, let alone two weeks. It's just been a solid block of feeling this way for the whole month.
You mentioned you didn't have the energy or interest in activities like hiking or reading, but can you tell me if there are any activities at all that you still find some pleasure in?

No... I really can't think of anything. I mean, I've tried to just sit and watch a show or listen to music, but... no, there's really nothing. It all just feels completely flat. I'm not getting any enjoyment out of anything right now.
Have you experienced any periods in the last month where your symptoms were so severe that you were unable to leave your home or perform even the simplest tasks?

Actually, yes. I know I said earlier that I'm keeping up with the basics right now, but there was a period recently where it all just fell apart. 

At work, I was making really questionable calls and... just falling apart in meetings. My supervisor actually had to step in and take me off active project decisions. And at home, I did completely stop keeping up with my basic routines for a bit. It got so bad that I ended up being sent to the emergency department, mostly because I just... I didn't feel safe with my own thoughts anymore.
